questions.prompt_html: \text{已知} \frac{ (x + ay) dx + y dy }{ (x + y)^{2}} \text{为某函数的全微分，则} a = ( \quad )。

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}M = \frac{x+ay}{\left(x+y\right)^2}, N = \frac{y}{\left(x+y\right)^2}, \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} \Rightarrow (a-2)x + (2-a)y = 0 \Rightarrow a = 2 \enspace ,\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \Delta z = \dfrac{y+\Delta y}{x+\Delta x}-\dfrac{y}{x}, dz = -\dfrac{y}{x^{2}}\, dx + \dfrac{1}{x}dy, \stackrel{y}{=} x=2, y=1, \Delta x=0.1, \Delta y=-0.2 \text{时}, \\ \\ \Delta z\big|_{\begin{subarray}{c}x=2\\ y=1\end{subarray}} = \dfrac{1-0.2}{2+0.1}-\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{0.8}{2.1}-0.5 = -0.119, dz\big|_{\begin{subarray}{c}x=2\\ y=1\end{subarray}} = -\dfrac{1}{4}\cdot 0.1 + \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot (-0.2) = -0.125 \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}f(x,y)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{x^{2}y^{2}}{x^{4}+y^{4}},&(x,y)\neq(0,0)\\ 0&(x,y)=(0,0)\end{cases}\text{在点}(0,0)\text{处( }\quad).^{a}

options.html: \text{既不连续又不可导};

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由于}f_{x}(0,0)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,0)-f(0,0)}{x}=0,\quad f_{y}(0,0)=\lim_{y\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(0,y)-f(0,0)}{y}=0,\\&\text{因此函数可导；但记}x=\rho\cos\theta,y=\rho\sin\theta,(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)\text{等价于}\rho\rightarrow 0,\\&\text{而}\lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)}f(x,y)=\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\frac{\rho^{4}\cos^{2}\theta\sin^{2}\theta}{\rho^{4}\cos^{4}\theta+\rho^{4}\sin^{4}\theta}=\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos^{2}\theta\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{4}\theta+\sin^{4}\theta}\text{不存在，因此不连续，从而不可微.}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{下列关于函数全微分的计算，正确的有（　）.}\\&(\text{1}).\text{函数}z=4xy^{3}+5x^{2}y^{6}\text{的全微分}dz=(4y^{3}+10xy^{6})dx+(12xy^{2}+30x^{2}y^{5})dy;\\&(\text{2}).\text{函数}z=e^{xy}\text{在点}（2,1）\text{处的全微分为}dz=e^{2}dx+2e^{2}dy;\\&(\text{3}).\text{函数}u=x^{y^{2}}\text{的全微分为}du=x^{y^{2}}\left(\frac{y^{z}}{x}dx+\frac{zy^{z}\ln x}{y}dy+y^{z}\cdot\ln x\ln ydz\right);\\&(\text{4}).\text{函数}f(x,y)=\begin{cases}(x^{2}+y^{2})\sin\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}},x^{2}+y^{2}\neq 0,\\0,&x^{2}+y^{2}=0.\end{cases}\text{在点}（0.0）\text{处可微分}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}(1).&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=4y^3+10xy^6;\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=12xy^2+30x^2y^2,\text{且这两个偏导数连续}, \\\text{所以}&dz=(4y^3+10xy^6)dx+(12xy^2+30x^2y^5)dy.2).&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=ye^{iy},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=xe^{iy},\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,1)}=e^2,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(2,1)}=2e^2,\text{所求全微分}dz=e^2dx+2e^2dy.3).&\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=y^z\cdot x^{z-1}=\frac{y^z}{x}x^{z-1},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=x^{z-1}\cdot z\cdot y^{z-1}\cdot\ln x=\frac{z\cdot y^z\cdot \ln x}{y},\\&\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=x^{z-1}\cdot \ln x\cdot y^z\cdot \ln y=x^{z-1}\cdot y^z\cdot \ln x\ln y\\\text{所以}&dtu=\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}dx+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}dy+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}dz=x^{z-1}\left(\frac{y^z}{x}dx+\frac{z y^z}{y}\ln x dy+y^z\cdot \ln x\ln y dz\right),4).&\text{因为}f_z(0,0)=\lim_{\Delta x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(\Delta x,0)-f(0,0)}{\Delta x}=\lim_{\Delta x\rightarrow 0}\frac{(\Delta x)^2\sin\frac{1}{\sqrt{\Delta x}}}{\Delta x}=0,\ f_y(0,0)=0,\\\text{所以}&\\&\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\frac{\Delta z-(f_z(0,0)\Delta x+f_y(0,0)\Delta y)}{\rho}=\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\frac{\Delta z}{\rho}=\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\frac{\left[(\Delta x)^2+(\Delta y)^2\right]\sin\frac{1}{\sqrt{(\Delta x)^2+(\Delta y)^2}}}{\rho}\\&=\lim_{\rho\rightarrow 0}\rho\sin\frac{1}{\rho}=0.\end{aligned}
